addr: 259, 4th A Main Rd, opposite Bharath Cycle Hub, Sector A, Yelahanka Satellite Town, Yelahanka New Town, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560064, India

rev.t: This place is nice for the small kids to play and enjoy. It would be difficult in summer or under hot sun as the place can become more hot as there is no AC inside. But, it’s worth for the price. Small kids will enjoy.

My daughter had a fantastic time here. The staff is very nice and they accompany the kid so it's easier to explore in first go. I liked the setup altogether and safety and cleanliness. Now i will be a regular visitor here.

Worst experience. The slide visible in the picture is not at all safe. I've seen kids flying out of it. It's very very dangerous. And the staffs are rude. Definitely a no no to this place. Had a bad experience
